ModMetaData.name: Time to Graze
ModMetaData.author: frbyyy
ModMetaData.description:
A small animal husbandry expansion. When penned animals get hungry, your handlers rope them up, lead them out to a pasture zone to graze, and bring them back home.
Features: - New "Pasture" zone (Zones menu). Link one or more pastures to a pen; the herd is taken to the pasture with the most grass. - New "Grazing" tab on the pen marker: grazing hours, start conditions (hunger below X%, pen food running out), return conditions (everyone fed, end of hours or nightfall, danger), herd filter. - Grazing animals can still wander off, but less often than outside a pen. - Assign a shepherd (a colonist who watches the herd the whole time) and/or a herding dog (new "Herding" training). Guards make wandering and predator attacks much rarer, chase off predators, and the shepherd enjoys a quiet day at the pasture. - Everything is tunable in mod settings.
Herding can be trained by Husky, Labrador retriever, Yorkshire terrier, wolves and wargs. Other races can opt in by adding TTG_Herding to race/trainableTags.
Небольшое расширение животноводства: животновод сам выводит голодное стадо на пастбище, а пастух и пастушья собака его стерегут.
